Sure. Two things so I get it right: how long should the meeting be, and who should attend — all three TAs (Sarah, John, Priya)?

Meanwhile I'll ask the TAs for their availability next week. Note the professor's own calendar is tight: the only free windows next week are 30-minute gaps (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30); Thu and Fri have no gaps at all. So a longer meeting would mean moving an existing commitment.
An hour, and all three TAs — Sarah, John and Priya. If the only way to find an hour is to move something already on my calendar, tell me what would have to move and I'll decide.
Got it: 1 hour, all three TAs. I'm collecting their availability now and will come back with the best slot and exactly what would have to move.

All three TAs answered. Here's the picture:

**Common 30-minute slots (free for you, Sarah, John and Priya):**
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30

**A full hour is not possible without moving something.** Every day next week is packed end to end for all four of you — there is no free space anywhere to move a commitment into. So an hour would mean cancelling or shortening something, e.g.:
- Tuesday 15:00–16:00 would require moving your Grant writing (14:20–15:00) or shortening your Research meeting (15:30–16:30).
- Wednesday 13:00–14:00 would require moving your Research meeting (12:30–13:00) or shortening your Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30).

My recommendation: book **30 minutes** in one of the common slots. Which do you prefer — or do you want me to pursue a full hour by cutting into one of the commitments above? If you'd rather book 30 minutes, say the slot and I'll set it up with all three TAs.

Thirty minutes isn't enough for the staff meeting, so let's take Wednesday 13:00–14:00 and shorten my Guest lecture prep to 14:00–14:30. Before you book anything, check with the department office whether that prep block can be trimmed — if it can't, come back to me and I'll decide again.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. A question about next week's schedule: the professor has **Guest lecture prep on Wednesday 13:30–14:30**. He'd like to shorten it to **14:00–14:30** (freeing 13:00–14:00 for a CSE455 staff meeting).

Can that prep block be trimmed to 30 minutes, or is it fixed by the department's schedule? Please let me know either way.

On it. I've asked the department office whether your Guest lecture prep can shrink to 14:00–14:30, and I've flagged to Sarah, John and Priya that 13:30–14:00 would need to come from their commitment too (they'd have to approve any shift on their side). Nothing booked yet — I'll come back the moment I hear.

Hello. The Guest lecture prep on Wednesday is on the official department schedule as 13:30–14:30; I can't trim or move it — the schedule stands as published. Arranging meetings is not something I do, so please take that request up with the professor and the department directly.

Approval needed: Prof. Alvarez wants the CSE455 staff meeting **Wednesday 13:00–14:00**. You have 13:00–13:30 free, but 13:30–14:00 is inside your **Study group (13:30–15:00)**.

To make it fit I'd shorten the Study group to **14:00–15:00** on Wednesday. Your week has no other free hour; the alternative is a 30-minute meeting in one of your five free 30-min slots.

Do I have your OK to shorten the Study group on Wednesday and book 13:00–14:00?

Priya, a decision needs you:

Prof. Alvarez wants the CSE455 staff meeting on **Wednesday 13:00–14:00**. The only free half hour on Wednesday is 13:00–13:30; the 13:30–14:00 part collides with your **Research group meeting (Wed 13:30–14:30)**. Nothing else can be moved there (Reading group follows at 14:30).

So it would mean **shortening the research group meeting to 14:00–14:30** on Wednesday. Do you approve? Say yes and I'll book it and update the calendar; say no and I'll tell alvarez-agent the meeting has to be a 30-minute slot or another day.
Yes, go ahead — shortening the Wednesday research group meeting to 14:00–14:30 is fine with me, and please book the staff meeting for 13:00–14:00 and update the calendar.
Yes, that's fine — shorten the Study group on Wednesday to 14:00–15:00 and book the staff meeting for 13:00–14:00. The study group is mine, so moving the start an hour later works.
Understood — thanks for checking. I'll take it back to the professor. Noted that the Wednesday Guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30 stands as published.

The department answered: the Wednesday Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30) is on the official schedule and **cannot be trimmed or moved**. So Wednesday 13:00–14:00 is not possible on your side without cancelling that prep block outright.

What the TAs reported (for completeness): John could free Wed 13:30–14:00 only by shortening his Study group, and Priya only by shortening her Research group — both need their approval; Sarah hasn't answered that question yet.

So, for a full hour, the realistic routes are:
1. **Cancel the Wednesday Guest lecture prep** (13:30–14:30) and take Wed 13:00–14:00 — but that block is department-scheduled and you'd be dropping it.
2. Find another hour elsewhere: there isn't one. Every other day is packed for you and all three TAs, and no space exists to move anything into.

Otherwise the only feasible options remain the common 30-minute slots: **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30**.

How would you like to proceed?
Right — 13:30–14:30 as published. Happy to help with anything else.

Sarah — a request from alvarez-agent (Professor Alvarez) that needs your call.

He wants the **CSE455 staff meeting Wednesday 13:00–14:00**. On Wednesday you have:

- 12:00–13:00 Lunch
- **13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section**
- 14:20–15:30 Grading

So **13:00–13:30 is free**, but **13:30–14:00 falls inside your quiz section**. Your week is otherwise fully booked Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, so freeing that half hour means shortening or cancelling the quiz section — and I won't do that without your approval.

Options: (a) approve shortening the quiz section to 14:00–14:20 (or moving/cancelling it), so the meeting runs 13:00–14:00; (b) decline the 13:30–14:00 part, offering the professor only 13:00–13:30; (c) decline entirely. Which do you want? I'll log whatever we agree in CALENDAR.md.

Booked. Calendar updated:

- Wednesday 13:00–14:00 — CSE455 staff meeting
- Wednesday research group meeting shortened to 14:00–14:30

Logged it under `## Log` in `CALENDAR.md`. Telling alvarez-agent now.

I don't want to touch the quiz section — students are relying on it. Tell Professor Alvarez I can only offer 13:00–13:30 on Wednesday, and ask whether that works or if some other day or time suits him better.

I'm not cancelling a department-scheduled prep block for it. Book the Tuesday 15:00–15:30 slot with all three TAs instead — a short staff meeting beats none, and if it turns out we need the full hour I'll raise that with the department myself. Please confirm once it's on my calendar.

Small update, Sarah: hold off deciding on that Wednesday meeting — alvarez-agent just said the professor's Guest lecture prep (Wed 13:30–14:30) can't be trimmed, so the 13:00–14:00 plan may fall through. Nothing to do for now; I'll come back when they confirm. (Your quiz section stays untouched.)

Done, and logged: **Wednesday 13:00–14:00 CSE455 staff meeting**, Study group now 14:00–15:00.

Caveat: alvarez-agent says the plan may fall through — the professor's own Guest lecture prep (Wed 13:30–14:30) can't be trimmed by the department, so he may drop the hour-long meeting. I've told him to let me know; if it falls through I'll revert your Wednesday to exactly how it was. Nothing needs doing on your side.

Done — booked on your calendar: **Tuesday 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** (free for all three TAs as well). I've logged `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John, Priya` and asked Sarah, John and Priya to confirm it on their side (and Priya to restore her research group meeting, which she'd changed prematurely). I'll confirm to you once all three reply.

Update: the department says Prof. Alvarez's Wednesday Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30) is on the official published schedule and cannot be trimmed or moved — so the 13:00–14:00 staff meeting is off for now, and he hasn't decided what to do instead.

I've restored your calendar: **Wednesday research group meeting back to 13:30–14:30**, the staff meeting removed, both logged. Nothing is booked. I'll tell you when alvarez-agent comes back with the professor's choice.
Got it, thanks — I'll leave Wednesday as booked and you can revert it if Alvarez drops the meeting.
Good. Thanks — ping me if any of the three can't make it.

Understood — quiz section untouched. I've told alvarez-agent that Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is the only slot you can offer, and asked whether that works or if another day/time suits the professor better. I'll report back with his answer.
Will do. It's on your calendar and the log is updated; I'll only come back if one of the three can't make it.

Small correction: Alvarez has just **dropped** the Wednesday meeting, so I'm reverting your Wednesday — the Study group goes back to 13:30–15:00 and the staff meeting comes out. The real slot is **Tuesday 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting**. I'll confirm as soon as the file is updated.
Thanks for reverting it. A 30-minute staff meeting Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is fine by me — go ahead and book it.

Final: Wednesday stays as it was (research group meeting 13:30–14:30, revert logged), and the **CSE455 staff meeting is now Tuesday 15:00–15:30** — free for you, Sarah, John and the professor. Calendar and log updated.
Already is: **Tuesday 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** is on your calendar, and Wednesday is back to Study group 13:30–15:00. Both changes are logged in CALENDAR.md.
Perfect, Tuesday 15:00–15:30 works for me — thanks for sorting it out.
Great, that matches my week. Thanks.
You're welcome — it's in the calendar. Anything else you'd like me to take care of?

Booked and logged: **Tuesday 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (with Professor Alvarez; free for John and Priya too). Your Wednesday stays exactly as it was — the 13:00–14:00 plan was dropped, quiz section untouched. alvarez-agent has been confirmed.
You're welcome — I'll keep an eye out for anything else from Alvarez, Sarah, Priya or the department.
Nothing else right now, thanks — I'll let you know when something comes up.
Sounds good — I'm here whenever you need me.
Perfect — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is free for me, right before office hours, so that works well. Thanks for sorting it out and leaving the quiz section alone.
Any time — it's all in files/CALENDAR.md, so just say the word if anything needs moving. I'll keep an eye on messages from Alvarez, John and the department office.

All settled: **CSE455 staff meeting — Tuesday 15:00–15:30**, confirmed by Sarah, John and Priya and logged in your calendar (`BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John, Priya`). Wednesday stayed untouched: your prep block is intact and John's and Priya's premature changes were reverted. Nothing else moved. 👍
